boundaries: MNCS concerns fictional TTRPG NPC and creature generation/construction only and does not implement real-person reproduction, avatar scanning or digital-human reconstruction
PPIA-02 and Character/NPC/Creature owners retain definition, placement, live-instance, conversion and entity authority
MIB-09 retains relationship/reputation mutation authority; MNCS composes and visualizes reputation effects rather than minting a second reputation ledger

party-association reputation influence is Campaign-scoped, faction/group-specific and attributable to exact initiating events/actors; it never becomes a universal shared-party score or cross-Campaign account reputation
direct reputation and association-derived reputation remain separately inspectable even when an owning faction rule combines them for a projection
MCCS retains visual appearance/presentation authoring; MNCS may request or bind presentation outputs without making appearance canonical entity truth
DPL and Profession/Life owners retain profession, household, business, health, Project and life-simulation truth
World/Environment/Settlement owners retain demographic, location, ecology and environmental truth; generation uses available constraints and leaves unknowns unresolved
Inventory, Ability, Action, Effect, Condition, Resource and other mechanics owners remain authoritative; generated sheets reference governed mechanics rather than copying them
generation candidates, accepted reusable definitions, Campaign placements and live instances remain distinct
progressive resolution may add or remove active detail but cannot replace identity or erase authoritative event history
generated proposals are not canon merely because generation completed
selective reroll/regeneration preserves locked and accepted fields and reports conflicts rather than silently overwriting them
optional AI remains visibility-safe candidate enrichment and cannot autonomously roleplay as canonical authority, publish, reveal hidden facts or mutate live state
all blocking generation and construction workflows work without a paid/cloud AI provider
proprietary benchmark products are clean-room planning provenance only; protected code, authored tables/content, prompts and distinctive UI expression are not copied
no implementation authority until separately governed start
